method.unit: one race = one (hourly run, corridor, clip) quote cell; a route pools its clips
method.contest_rule: counted only if 1Click quoted ok and at least one competitor quoted ok
method.outcome_rule: win: headroom_bps >= +0.01; loss: headroom_bps <= -0.01; tie: |headroom_bps| < 0.01 (reported, excluded from wins and losses)
method.ci: 90% Wilson score interval on the win rate (z = 1.645). It treats races as independent; hourly races on one route are autocorrelated and the clips of one run share a market state, so the true uncertainty is wider than shown
method.beaten_by: best_competitor of each loss (the venue that delivered the most)
